list.title: On-call schedules
list.subtitle: One rotation, one timezone, one handoff time. Use escalation policies to wire schedules into paging.
list.emptyHint: Create a rotation to route alerts to active responders during scheduled shifts.

detail.deleteConfirmBody: This soft-deletes the schedule. Members of this rotation will no longer receive on-call paging until restored.
detail.noUsers: No users in the rotation. Add at least one user before this schedule can resolve.

ical.title: iCal feed
ical.description: Subscribe to this rotation in your calendar app. Anyone with the URL can read it — keep it private.
ical.rotateConfirmBody: Existing subscribers will start seeing 410 Gone immediately and will need the new URL to keep receiving updates.

detail.v1Notes: v1 supports a single layer with daily or weekly rotation. Need primary + secondary on-call? Use escalation policies — schedules represent one rotation.

form.name: Name
form.descriptionPlaceholder: Optional — who this rotation pages and when
form.startAtHelp: The rotation cycles forward from this point. Pick the moment user 0 should first be on call.
form.userUidsHelp: First user is on call from start_at; subsequent rotations move down the list.
form.startAtWarning: Changing the rotation epoch shifts who's currently on call.

errors.invalidTimezone: Timezone must be a valid IANA zone (e.g. Europe/Paris).
errors.weekdayRequired: Weekday is required for weekly rotations.
errors.weekdayUnused: Weekday is only used for weekly rotations.
errors.invalidRotation: Rotation must be daily or weekly.
errors.noUsers: Add at least one user to the rotation.
